name: CSOAI Over-Refusal Economics
description: GF-05 prices the business cost of a safety gate refusing too much: false_refusals = volume*overblock; total = lost revenue + escalation. Overblock inputs are MEASURED (care-gate 0.0, lora-v1 0.500, lora-v2 0.357, combo-lora 0.214); volume/price are operator inputs. Makes visible: composed model = 43% of the all-refusal LoRA's false-refusal cost with zero safety loss. Deterministic calculator, never a forecast.
honesty: simple explicit model; only overblock is measured, price/volume are operator inputs; a cost bound, not a forecast
